Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt

Christmas Sounds at the Ford

December 6, 2025 · Spitalkirche Ochsenfurt

For over ten years, the summer series "Music at the Ford" has been taking place. Some members of the Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt (CMI) under the direction of Astrid Eitschberger first came up with the idea of creating a winter edition as well, and so there was an introduction to the Christmas season on two consecutive Saturdays. A small group of brass and string players made music together with the Ukrainian vocal ensemble FAINO (director: Viktoriia Hromova). The audience was invited to actively participate: through prepared posters with the individual song verses, everyone present could sing along together. The contribution from the donation box was sent directly to a doctor in Ukraine with whom one of the choir singers is personally in contact. A heartfelt thank you to all participants, supporters, and spontaneous co-singers who, despite the wintry weather, set a sign of solidarity and humanity together!
